setup: The angle in question measures [[given]] degrees.

steps.say: A right angle is exactly 90 degrees, and the two parts of it must add to 90 — so the other angle is 90 − [[given]] = [[missing]].
Angles are named by their size: acute is under 90, right is exactly 90, obtuse is over 90 but under 180, and straight is 180. [[given]] degrees is therefore an [[cls]] angle.
